pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 16
   C. 5
   D. 8

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 33
   C. 28
   D. 22

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

7. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 45
   C. 18
   D. 30

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

12. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
